commits.message:
build: restructure monoline as playground and library monorepo

Create a workspace split between the Next.js playground app and the publishable @chitrank2050/monoline-ui package.

The playground now lives under apps/playground and consumes the local design library through workspace:* so it can render the same package consumers will install. The library lives under packages/monoline-ui and keeps its npm-focused build, package exports, theme CSS, footer component, and tests isolated from the playground.

Replace commitlint with git-hygiene for commit and branch validation, keep Lefthook as the hook runner, and update root scripts so pnpm dev starts the playground while pnpm build builds only the library package. Add initial App Router pages for introduction, installation, foundations, and the footer component route.

Verification:
- pnpm format:check
- pnpm lint
- pnpm build
- pnpm test
- pnpm build:playground
- pnpm --filter @chitrank2050/monoline-ui pack --dry-run
- pnpm exec lefthook validate
- pnpm exec git-hygiene branch

commits.message: restructure monoline as playground and library monorepo
commits.body:
Create a workspace split between the Next.js playground app and the publishable @chitrank2050/monoline-ui package.

The playground now lives under apps/playground and consumes the local design library through workspace:* so it can render the same package consumers will install. The library lives under packages/monoline-ui and keeps its npm-focused build, package exports, theme CSS, footer component, and tests isolated from the playground.

Replace commitlint with git-hygiene for commit and branch validation, keep Lefthook as the hook runner, and update root scripts so pnpm dev starts the playground while pnpm build builds only the library package. Add initial App Router pages for introduction, installation, foundations, and the footer component route.

- pnpm build
- pnpm test
- pnpm build:playground
- pnpm --filter @chitrank2050/monoline-ui pack --dry-run
- pnpm exec lefthook validate
- pnpm exec git-hygiene branch
